name: Saku Yoshijirou
source:
Yoshijirou Saku is the unlikely protagonist of the series. A recent second-year transfer student, his life takes an unexpected turn when he is blamed for fighting and threatened with expulsion, along with fellow classmate [url=/c1757]Mirai Aoi[/url]. Given the chance to redress his actions, Yoshijirou is assigned to recruit his entire class, a notorious group of disobedient misfits, to perform in a play lest having to leave school permanently with them.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors]Wikipedia[/url].]
